mono.subject: oscar-best-picture-040
mono.title: 炎热的夜晚
mono.titleEnglish: In the Heat of the Night

phrase.zh: 让证据成为共同的起点。

visual.zh: 暗色木桌上，双手从左右两侧伸向同一张空白纸，中央偏下放着圆形放大镜；右上角台灯照亮纸张，保留夜色与木纹。黑白版保留两只手的明暗差异与镜片纸纹。
visual.en: Across a dark wooden table, hands approach the same blank sheet from opposite sides. A round magnifying glass sits near the foreground and a lamp at upper right lights the paper. Neutral monochrome preserves hand tonal differences and paper fibers through the lens.

background.zh:
《炎热的夜晚》是1967年上映的影片，在1968年第40届奥斯卡获得最佳影片奖。影片讲述黑人费城警探维吉尔·蒂布斯卷入密西西比州斯巴达镇的谋杀案调查，与当地抱有种族偏见的警长展开艰难合作。画面以不同肤色的双手共同审视空白纸张与放大镜，表达偏见之下仍需围绕证据合作的关系。这是原创寓意，不是电影剧照、演员肖像或真实案件证物，也不表示影片中冲突已经消失。短句为原创。
第40届奥斯卡最佳影片：炎热的夜晚。颁奖年份 1968；参评年份 1967。
background.en:
In the Heat of the Night was released in 1967 and won Best Picture at the 40th Academy Awards in 1968. Black Philadelphia detective Virgil Tibbs becomes involved in a murder investigation in Sparta, Mississippi, and forms an uneasy working alliance with a prejudiced local police chief. Anonymous hands of different skin tones consider a blank sheet and magnifying glass, an original metaphor for difficult cooperation around evidence. This is not a film still, an actor portrait or real case material, and does not suggest the story’s conflict has disappeared. The phrase is original.
Academy Awards ceremony 40 (1968), Best Picture: In the Heat of the Night. Eligibility year: 1967.
